verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's official CUDA Toolkit and CUDA-X documentation explicitly list this GPU as a supported target, including CUDA C/C++, cuTile Python/C++, and RAPIDS acceleration, confirming first-party toolchain support. One community report notes that its SM120 architecture lacks tmem/tcgen05 support in some main libraries versus data-center Blackwell parts, a minor limitation rather than a lack of CUDA support overall. Missing for 10: independent benchmark corroboration of full library parity and explicit ROCm/HIP status (not applicable since NVIDIA doesn't ship AMD toolchain).
